novelty_flags.label: Proposition 2: full-branch-map tomography
novelty_flags.one_line: Once local branch matrices span every input-output matrix, linear recovery of the full process tensor is ordinary process tomography, already covered by Friend et al.'s spanning-preparation/effect tomography examples.

soundness_flags.label: ass:strict-source-positivity
soundness_flags.one_line: Kivva et al.'s positivity condition is positivity of every observed realization P_M(v), not strict positivity of every primitive latent-source atom.

soundness_flags.label: ass:strict-mechanism-positivity
soundness_flags.one_line: Kivva et al. do not make every structural-kernel cell strictly positive their standard positivity condition; this is a stronger model-class restriction and needs a novel tag and justification.

soundness_flags.label: Proposition 3: front-door numeric reduction
soundness_flags.one_line: The eight-coordinate q_f has no declared axes or lexicographic order, while R_f has four entries; 'invert within each observed-X slice' does not specify a map from the former to the latter or the probabilities used in the front-door functional.

soundness_flags.label: Open-ended Question 1: district-positive gluing
soundness_flags.one_line: ProbeID has no q input, but its asserted return condition is indexed by the q-specific fiber Θ_x,y(q); state either global identification for every attainable q or an algorithm that receives q and decides pointwise.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorem 2: regular circuit inference
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The result is conditional on ProbeID having already returned a fixed regular circuit, with nonzero denominators, a locally fixed algebraic branch, and positive delta-method variance.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Asymptotic normality and Wald coverage hold only on a fixed regular returned-circuit stratum; they are not a uniform inference theorem across rank or branch changes.
